stem: A pH meter was stored dry even though its procedure requires storage solution. What should the technician do before trusting the next reading?
choices: Use the meter because the display still turns on
Follow the meter recovery/verification procedure and confirm performance with the approved standard before using it for a critical decision
Add fertilizer until the reading looks familiar
Compare it only with yesterday's handwritten value
rationale: Meter condition and verification affect measurement reliability. A plausible display value is not enough after improper storage.
